Recorded by tools/check_image.py in the final Grid image with Limen 5.27.0,
Node 24, and a 2-CPU quota. All 40 native factorized rule rounds completed.
Input OHLC bars are deterministic synthetic data from generate_rule_run.py;
Limen wrote metadata, CSV metrics and each round's execution/model outputs.
The original source path in metadata is an ephemeral Parquet generated by
that script. Offline tests use recorded artifacts; the image smoke recreates
the source and verifies real native execution and public cohort evaluation.
